tasks.title: Implement todo data access functions
acceptance: add_todo(title, description, priority) returns a dict with id, title, description, priority
update_todo(todo_id, title, description, priority) returns True if a row was updated
delete_todo(todo_id) returns True if a row was deleted
the table is created automatically on first use

tasks.title: Implement the todos API router
acceptance: POST /api/todos returns 201 with id, title, description, priority
POST with an empty title returns 400 {"detail": "Title must not be empty"}
POST with an invalid priority returns 400 {"detail": "Priority must be one of 'low', 'medium', 'high'"}
PUT with an invalid priority returns 400 {"detail": "Priority must be one of 'low', 'medium', 'high'"}

tasks.title: Build the page structure and style
acceptance: index.html has a form with inputs id=title, id=description, id=priority and a Save button
an element id=list holds the todos

tasks.title: Write the page script
acceptance: loads GET /api/todos on page load and renders items.title, items.description, items.priority
submitting the form POSTs to /api/todos then reloads the list
shows the API's detail text on a 400
